proposed_next_phase.name: POSTHOC_METADATA_QUALITY_FOLLOWUP
proposed_next_phase.motivation: The completed May2017 large-displacement reference was low-continuum in 10 of 12 profiles. This new quality-focused question is motivated after observing that result; it is explicitly posthoc, not an extension or replacement of the completed fixed two-epoch run.
proposed_next_phase.deterministic_provisional_selection: Among unused saved HD122640 metadata candidates observed in May2017, select highest finite positive ObsCore snr; tie lexicographically smallest dp_id. No line flux, local correlation or unseen spectrum is inspected for this choice.
proposed_next_phase.SNR_definition: ESO-specific field not present in the standard ObsCore. The average signal-to-noise ratio of a spectrum. Not applicable to other data product types.
proposed_next_phase.SNR_limitation: Average spectrum metadata SNR is neither local blue continuum quality nor a calibrated error or promised sensitivity gain. Higher average SNR does not guarantee useful 3866–3881 Angstrom profiles or repeatability. Candidate BERV, mode, units and array quality are not yet verified.
proposed_next_phase.first_action_next_continue: Prepare and independently review a new exact one-product header/optional-payload/comparison protocol; freeze and publish it prospectively before any new header or array access. This handoff itself is not that freeze.
proposed_next_phase.header_then_payload_gate: Use the already documented header route and inherited identity/provenance/mode/representation checks. Verify finite recorded BERV and its intended large displacement from each HD122640 discovery epoch before releasing an optional payload. Freeze the exact BERV benchmark prospectively; this is a quality-reference study, so extending the already known 40.36348 km/s range is not required. No candidate substitution after failure.
proposed_next_phase.future_comparison_scope: All six preserved HD122640 events, both inherited frames, one additional archival epoch: 12 slots. Include V2E2-0235 as well as all five blue records. Retain blocked/low-continuum outcomes and both completed references. Keep all ten queue IDs, including the four HD135204 no-new-epoch records.
proposed_next_phase.method: Reuse frozen centers, windows, normalization, background and descriptive metrics. Do not optimize shifts/widths, relabel, promote a detection, replace the low-quality reference or refit a classifier.
proposed_next_phase.stop: Any identity/representation/BERV/transfer failure is an explicit stopped or blocked future phase; no automatic next-best May candidate, new target query or iterative quality-selection loop.

HD135204_route: No eligible rows under the completed exact public/single-exposure/date/name-coordinate/provenance query. Four U remain; this is not proof of no other observations in the full archive. No additional query is proposed in this handoff.

do_not_repeat.current_comparison: Completed 24 profiles / 12 pairs; do not reopen or expand that fixed run.

normalization.finding: All4 low profiles are a later reference epoch, neither discovery is low; positive scalar normalization alone cannot increase Pearson correlation.

do_not_repeat.original_epoch_pipeline: Original extension02 all336 comparison is complete:2185 pairs/4370 profiles. Do not rerun to recreate this metadata inventory.
do_not_repeat.metadata_and_header_routes: All original failures/amendments are preserved. Do not rerun previous queries, header batches or payload acquisition to obtain this handoff.
